description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Kottala, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510248
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of a land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about a specific parcel of land (No. 99, 420 of Block 01) including its location, cadastral map reference, and amendments to the title particulars regarding access rights and servitude. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property rights, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
